audit_002_save_reload_proof.root_cause_before_fix: CanvaAutoSaveSync (which wires useAutoSave → scheduleAutoSave → saveToStorage) was only rendered inside CanvaBuilder (legacy editor). V5's CleanEditorV5 did not render it, so schema edits existed only in memory and were lost on reload.
audit_002_save_reload_proof.fix_applied: ProductShell now wraps children in ProjectProvider and renders CanvaAutoSaveSync. This connects the dirty store subscription to the debounced auto-save scheduler.
audit_002_save_reload_proof.verification_method: localStorage.getItem('canva_state_v2') before reload — both fields present. After reload + Lanjut Edit, both fields verified via DOM textContent + inspector textarea value.

steps.action: Click 'Export' button in CleanEditorV5 top bar

audit_003_export_single_path_proof.root_cause_before_fix: CleanEditorV5's Export button called both onExport() AND exportHtml() (via useExportActions), causing double export when user subsequently clicked 'Export Sekarang' in ExportPanelV5.
audit_003_export_single_path_proof.fix_applied: CleanEditorV5's Export button now ONLY calls onExport() (navigate). useExportActions is no longer imported. Export pipeline runs exclusively when user clicks 'Export Sekarang' in ExportPanelV5.

audit_001_recursive_guard_proof.fix_applied: All teacherMode ternaries in BlockContextMenu.tsx replaced with the teacherMode=true branch (Indonesian labels). V5 has no advanced mode, so teacherMode is always true. teacherMode variable declaration removed.
audit_001_recursive_guard_proof.guard_output_after_fix: ✅ PASS — recursive guard found no legacy runtime imports. Runtime import graph (328 files) is clean.

audit_005_dead_useeffect_cleanup.description: Removed dead useEffect in ProductShell that only checked pages.length > 0 && view === 'dashboard' without any side effect. The 'Lanjut Edit' enable/disable state is already handled by DashboardV5 via the hasProject prop.

audit_004_metadata_template_limitation.description: Template metadata (judulPertemuan, guru, sekolah, kelas) is currently set to template defaults. V5 does not provide a metadata edit form. Teachers cannot customize the cover title's subtitle, guru name, or school name from the UI.
audit_004_metadata_template_limitation.workaround: Teachers can edit individual block fields via the inspector (Cover title, Cover subtitle) but the global metadata that populates cover badges (Guru, Sekolah, Mapel, Kelas) is not editable in V5.
audit_004_metadata_template_limitation.deferred_to: Future batch — needs a small metadata form in CleanEditorV5 top bar or DashboardV5 'Project Info' card. Senior instruction: 'Jangan buat form besar dulu.'

theme_override_by_contract.description: PPKn template applies contractId='golden-pertemuan' to every page. PageRenderer's contract enforcement (resolveContractStyle + shouldUseGoldenLegacyFallback) overrides the schema.themeId set by WorkspaceStyleMenu. As a result, clicking 'Sekolah Ceria' or 'Modern Interaktif' in the style menu does not change the visual appearance of PPKn template pages.
theme_override_by_contract.deferred_to: Future batch — needs either (a) strip contractId when user changes style, or (b) make style menu aware of contract and remove contractId on apply.
